citations.narrative:
Acquisition records are missing for three young deer and six goats. Not having acquisition records for all regulated
animals doesn't allow for APHIS officials to properly track the animals through the facility. All acquisition information must
be documented and recorded for all regulated animals going forward. Correct starting on 9/8/26.

The primary enclosure for the deer is in disrepair in two spots. On the east side, the fence is sagging. On the northwest
side, the fence is sagging and sharp points are protruding into the enclosure. A sagging fence could allow for the deer to
jump the fence and escape the enclosure. Sharp points sticking inwards could potentially cause injury to the deer. The
enclosure must be constructed of such material and of such strength as appropriate for the animals involved. The fence
must be repaired or replaced so there are no sharp points sticking inwards and the fence is not sagging. It needs to be
maintained in good repair to protect the animals from injury and to contain the animals. Correct by 10/1/26.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
End of report.
